results.description:
I never thought I’d belong in their world. But maybe it’s been in my blood all along.

My mother’s death left me with one final secret: the name of my biological father—and where to find him.

Crossing two states doesn’t scare me. Facing the president of a one-percenter motorcycle club does.

The Wild Crows live by their own rules, where respect has to be earned and freedom is worth fighting for. I should feel completely out of place among them.

Instead, something about their world feels strangely right.

Maybe because his blood runs through my veins.

Maybe because I’m one of them.

I came looking for a father. I never expected to find a family—or a place that could change everything I thought I knew about loyalty, freedom… and eventually, love.

Because with the Wild Crows, nothing comes without a price.

___________________
Romantic suspense - bikers - series

Content Warnings:
• Violence
• Sexual assault
• Firearms
• Drug use
